thread:
Miguel: Hey team — new POC for Orion Retail. They want a dedicated pool in APAC (ap-southeast-1) with mixed SKUs. Need help sizing and access for their infra folks.
Jess: Nice — high level ask?
Miguel: They expect ~150 concurrent requests peak, avg seq len 512, want low latency for chat. Prefer H100 for heavy gen and A100 for costed background jobs. Asking for isolation (VPC peering) + temporary hosted API keys for dev.
Jess: Ok. Ballpark capacity: for 150 concurrent at 512, I'd suggest 4x H100 + 8x A100 as a starting point (can autoscale). That gives headroom for KV cache + batching.
Rahul: For ap-southeast-1 we have limited H100 slots — provisioning lead time ~3-5 business days. A100 capacity is fine. Do they need GPU tenancy pinned or just reserved pool?
Miguel: Reserved pool with tenant isolation (no noisy neighbors). Also need peered VPC and CIDR allowlist for app servers.
Jess: Right. Access plan: 1) create dedicated pool with tenant tag, 2) set up VPC peering and SG rules, 3) provide scoped API keys for dev and prod roles, 4) enable KV cache and batching defaults.
Sam: Security Qs: will customer-managed KMS be required? Any data residency/regulatory constraints?
Miguel: They require keys in their KMS and audit logs for inference requests. No strict residency beyond APAC region.
Sam: We can support customer KMS in Private, but for Dedicated we need to confirm keyflow. I need to open a security ticket for KMS integration and audit retention windows.
Jess: For POC, we can do temporary hosted API keys that rotate every 30 days, and provide request-level logs to their SIEM via export. For KMS integration we'll need Private deployment or additional entitlements — I'll run the ask.
Rahul: Action items for infra: - confirm H100 quota (prod vs poc) - reserve 4 H100 + 8 A100 in ap-southeast-1 - create VPC peering request with their CIDR - prepare tenant-scoped API key template
Jess: Miguel, can you share their CIDR block and point of contact? Also need their expected timeline — POC start date?
Miguel: POC target start: 2026-04-06. POC contact: devops@orion-retail.com (Samir). CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16.
Rahul: Noted. I'll check H100 availability and post back. If H100 constrained, fallback plan: 2x H100 + 6x A100 and turn on quantized model variant for some routes.
Jess: Pricing note to AE: Rough monthly committed cost (estimate): H100 ~ $20k/month each, A100 ~ $6k/month each — with POC discount we can offer ~20% off for first 3 months. Miguel pls confirm commercial ok.
Miguel: I'll loop in sales ops.
deploy-bot: Created ticket #4872: "POC - Orion Retail - Dedicated pool provision (ap-southeast-1)" — assignees: @Rahul, @Jess.
Sam: I'll create security checklist: KMS flow, audit retention (90 days?), SIEM export method, and answer their questionnaire.
Jess: Great. Rahul — can you confirm ETA for reserved pool and whether we need any infra change?
Rahul: ETA: provision request submitted by EOD, tentative avail date 2026-04-02. If cloud partner needs approval might be +1 business day. Will update in ticket #4872.
Miguel: Awesome. Thanks all. I'll send the customer the access plan and timeline. :thumbsup:
Jess: Thanks — I'll draft the API key rotation and scoped policy template and attach to the ticket.
Miguel: One more — customer asked about monitoring: can we expose per-tenant token-level latency/cost dashboards during POC?
Jess: Yes, Redwood Console has per-route and per-token breakdowns. I'll enable a temporary dashboard with 30-day retention for the POC.
Rahul: Quick note: if they want private KMS with Dedicated we may need Private deployment legal sign-off. Flagging to Sam.
Sam: Acknowledged — will coordinate with legal.
Miguel: Perfect. I'll mark this thread as blocking only until provisioned.
Jess: Tags: @Rahul please add pool config to ticket, @Sam please attach security checklist.
Rahul: Will do.
Miguel: Thanks team.
